prTitle: Improve MistralAiApi Jackson mapping for message content

content.motivation: The code changes aim to enhance the Mistral AI chat model integration by adding support for new features such as "thinking" models, improved handling of media content (images), structured output with JSON schema, and more robust error handling with retries. It also updates dependencies and refactors existing code for better clarity and maintainability.
goodPoints: Introduction of "thinking" model support with `reasoningEffort` and specific model handling.
Enhanced media content handling for `UserMessage` to support images and structured content chunks.
Improved JSON serialization/deserialization for `ChatCompletionMessage` content, allowing complex structures.
Refactored `MistralAiChatModel` for better readability and modularity, including dedicated methods for metadata building and tool call mapping.
Added integration tests (`MistralAiChatModelIT`, `MistralAiApiIT`) to cover new features like "thinking" models, citations, and multi-modal input.
More granular handling of `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionMessage.ContentChunk` with dedicated types like `ImageUrlChunk`, `ReferenceChunk`, `TextChunk`, and `ThinkChunk`.
Improved retry logic in `MistralAiRetryTests` for transient errors.
Refined `MistralAiApi` client with better error handling and support for streaming API.
badPoints: The `jsonHelper` field in `MistralAiApi` and `MistralAiChatModelIT` is declared as a constant but not named in uppercase (`[A-Z][A-Z_0-9]*`), violating the `FieldNamingConventions` PMD rule.
Some `Logger` calls in `MistralAiChatModelIT` are not guarded by log level checks, violating the `GuardLogStatement` PMD rule.
The `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionMessage.ContentDeserializer` and `ContentSerializer` classes could be made static as they do not depend on the instance state of `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionMessage`.
The `MistralAiRetryTests.TestRetryListener` class has only private constructors and should be marked as final.

The `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionMessage` methods `extractThinkingReferenceContent`, `extractReferenceContent`, `extractReferenceIdsFromReferenceChunk`, and `flatten` return null when no data is found, but PMD suggests returning an empty collection instead.
The `MistralAiStreamFunctionCallingHelper.merge` method reassigns the `current` parameter, which is flagged by the `AvoidReassigningParameters` PMD rule.
content.suggestion: Address the PMD violations related to constant naming, logger guarding, static inner classes, final modifiers for utility classes, returning empty collections instead of null, and parameter reassignment. These are mostly style and best practice improvements that will enhance code quality.

details: Replaced `micrometer-observation-test` dependency with `jsonassert` for testing.
Introduced new metadata constants: `REFERENCE_CONTENT_METADATA`, `REFERENCE_THINKING_CONTENT_METADATA`, `THINKING_CONTENT_METADATA`.
Refactored metadata building logic into `buildMetadata` method.
Updated `buildGeneration` to use `choice.message().extractTextContent()` and `mapToolCall` for tool calls.
Modified `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionRequest` construction to include `reasoningEffort`.
Introduced `ContentChunk` related helper methods for handling `UserMessage` media content, including `ImageUrlChunk`, `TextChunk`, `ReferenceChunk`, and `ThinkChunk`.
Added support for `reasoningEffort` in `MistralAiChatOptions` and its builder.
Updated `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionRequest` to include `reasoningEffort`.
Modified `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionMessage` to handle `ContentChunk` in its `content` field, including custom `ContentSerializer` and `ContentDeserializer`.
Added `ThinkingContentChunk` marker interface and `ThinkChunk` record.
Introduced new `ChatCompletionMessage` methods: `extractThinkingReferenceContent`, `extractThinkingTextContent`, `extractReferenceContent`, `extractTextContent`.
Added `reasoningEffort` field to `MistralAiChatOptions` to control the reasoning effort level for thinking models.
Updated constructors and builder to include `reasoningEffort`.
Added `reasoningEffort` to `equals` and `hashCode` methods.
Introduced `ChatCompletionRequest.ReasoningEffort` enum.
Updated `ChatCompletionRequest` record to include `reasoningEffort` parameter.
Introduced `ChatCompletionMessage.ContentChunk` sealed interface and its implementations (`ImageUrlChunk`, `ReferenceChunk`, `TextChunk`, `ThinkChunk`).
Added `ChatCompletionMessage.ThinkingContentChunk` marker interface.
Implemented `ContentSerializer` and `ContentDeserializer` for `ChatCompletionMessage.content` field.
Renamed `ChatCompletionFinishReason` to `FinishReason` and adjusted its members.
Modified `ChatCompletionMessage` to support a list of `ContentChunk` for its `content` field and added extraction methods for different content types.
Added `ImageUrlChunk.ImageUrl.ImageDetail` enum.
Updated `ImageUrlChunk.ImageUrl` with `fromImageData` static factory methods.
Updated `ChatCompletionRequest` constructors to accommodate the `reasoningEffort` parameter.
Updated `merge` method to use the new `FinishReason` enum.
Refactored `merge` method to avoid reassigning the `current` parameter.
Added integration tests for "thinking" models (`thinkingCall`, `thinkingStream`) using `@ThinkingModelSource` and `@ParameterizedTest`.
Added integration test for citations and references (`referenceCall`).
Updated assertions to check for the presence of new metadata keys (`REFERENCE_CONTENT_METADATA`, `REFERENCE_THINKING_CONTENT_METADATA`, `THINKING_CONTENT_METADATA`).
Refactored `MistralAiApiIT` to use `ThinkingModelSource` and `ThinkingModelUtils` for "thinking" model tests.
Added tests for multi-modal input with images (`multiModalityEmbeddedImage`, `multiModalityImageUrl`).
Added `ThinkingModelSource` and `ThinkingModelUtils` for organizing "thinking" model tests.
Added tests for `ChatCompletionMessage` serialization/deserialization with various content types in `MistralAiChatCompletionMessageTests`.
Added comprehensive tests for `ChatCompletionMessage` content extraction methods in `MistralAiChatCompletionMessageTests`.
Updated tests to use the new `ContentChunk` types and extraction methods.
Added tests for the new `reasoningEffort` option.
Updated `testCopy` and `testSetters` to include `reasoningEffort`.
Updated tests to use the new `FinishReason` enum.
Disabled streaming retry tests as they are not yet implemented.
Added a `TestRetryListener` inner class and ensured it's final.
Added integration tests for multi-modal input with `ImageUrlChunk` and `TextChunk`.
Added integration tests for "thinking" models using `ChatCompletionRequest.ReasoningEffort`.
Added integration test for text chunk and reference chunk content.
Updated `chatCompletionEntity` to test with `TextChunk` and `ImageUrlChunk`.
Added helper methods to extract text and thinking text content from `ChatCompletionMessage`.
Added helper methods to create `ChatCompletionRequest` for "thinking" models and for text/reference content.
Updated `embeddings` test assertions.
Added `hasContent` helper method for stream tests.
Introduced extensive unit tests for serialization and deserialization of `ChatCompletionMessage` with string and `ContentChunk` content.

Added dedicated test classes for `ContentSerializer`, `ContentDeserializer`, and extraction methods (`extractChatCompletionMessageReferenceContentTests`, `extractChatCompletionMessageTextContentTests`, `extractChatCompletionMessageThinkingReferenceContentTests`, `extractChatCompletionMessageThinkingTextContentTests`).
Used `JacksonTester` and `BasicJsonTester` for robust JSON testing.
Created mock `ContentChunk` data and corresponding JSON strings for testing.
Updated assertions to use `extractTextContent` for response content.
Refactored logger calls to be guarded.
Updated `MistralAiRuntimeHintsTests` to register `MistralAiApi.FinishReason` instead of `MistralAiApi.ChatCompletionFinishReason`.
Example JSON for a `ChatCompletionMessage` with various `ContentChunk` types.
Example JSON for a `ChatCompletionMessage` with simple string content.
Example JSON representing a list of `ContentChunk` objects.
